claim_text: The complaint states that federal law enforcement never searched Zorro Ranch, and cites a federal email of 23 August 2019 — thirteen days after Epstein's death — that acknowledged a victim who may have been raped at the New Mexico residence while asserting there was no probable cause to search it.
quote: But federal law enforcement failed to ever search Zorro Ranch.
confidence_justification: The filing quotes and Bates-cites the email (EFTA00165502) to a public justice.gov URL. The existence and content of that email are documented; whether the probable-cause assessment was correct is not a question this record settles.
